Delhi.text: SPA New Delhi admits B.Arch/B.Plan through JEE Main Paper 2 and JoSAA/CSAB counselling (per SPA's 2025-26 fee notice). GGSIPU admits B.Arch on NATA with 85% Delhi / 15% outside-Delhi seats per an aggregator (not verified officially).

Haryana.text: Only NIT Kurukshetra (JoSAA/CSAB, JEE Main route) surfaced; a Haryana state B.Arch counselling authority and NRI rule were not verified.

Punjab.text: Private universities (Chandigarh Univ., LPU, Chitkara) run their own admissions using NATA and/or JEE Main Paper 2 plus own entrance (CUCET, LPUNEST) per aggregators; no Punjab state counselling for these was verified.

Chandigarh.text: Chandigarh College of Architecture seats are reported (aggregators, conflicting) to be filled via JAC Chandigarh counselling using JEE Main Paper 2A and/or NATA; verify on the JAC Chandigarh portal.

Himachal Pradesh.text: NIT Hamirpur admits B.Arch via JEE Main Paper 2 through JoSAA/CSAB (aggregator-sourced). No state-level B.Arch counselling or NRI rule verified.

Jammu & Kashmir.text: SMVDU (official notice): B.Arch selection is on JEE Main Paper-2 AIR or a valid NATA score, seats reserved per SRO 176 of J&K Social Welfare Dept; spot round run by the university. IUST requires NATA (2024 prospectus per search result; JEE Paper 2A accepted in 2023). NRI quota not verified.

Uttarakhand.text: IIT Roorkee admits B.Arch via JEE Advanced (AAT) per Careers360; no state counselling for it. Other Uttarakhand colleges were not researched.

Uttar Pradesh.text: AKTU-affiliated colleges fill B.Arch through UPTAC counselling after NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 (aggregator). AMU runs its own admission (NATA/AMU entrance per aggregators). NRI quota rule not verified.

Rajasthan.text: MNIT Jaipur admits B.Arch through JoSAA; Manipal University Jaipur admits on NATA with PCM marks (aggregators). No Rajasthan government state-counselling college verified.

Gujarat.text: B.Arch admission is run by the Admission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC Gujarat), which uses NATA scores (plus JEE Main Paper 2 in the merit); the 2026-27 B.Arch online programme opened 19 May 2026. Private universities such as Nirma reserve about 15% seats as NRI/NRI-sponsored (fee in USD) and fill the rest via ACPC and All India categories; UTU describes 25% Management/NRI quota filled on merit under ACPC procedure (older page).

Maharashtra.text: The State CET Cell runs the B.Arch Centralised Admission Process (CAP) at cetcell.mahacet.org; there is no separate state B.Arch CET, merit uses NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 (NATA/2 + Class 12 aggregate %). Supernumerary seats (NRI/OCI/PIO, J&K migrants, TFWS 5% for income under Rs 8 lakh) sit above sanctioned intake. Source is a coaching-institute guide (medium), confirm on the CET Cell portal.

Goa.text: Goa College of Architecture (Altinho, Panaji) is a government college affiliated to Goa University with intake of 60 B.Arch seats including seats for other states (Goa govt page). Admission is understood to be NATA-based via DTE Goa (2026 notice exists at dte.goa.gov.in but could not be read); no NRI rule verified.

Madhya Pradesh.text: DTE Madhya Pradesh counselling admits to B.Arch on NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 scores (separate merit lists, no separate state entrance); SPA Bhopal and MANIT admit centrally via JoSAA/CSAB (and DASA for NRI/foreign). NRI/management quota rules for private MP colleges not verified.

Chhattisgarh.text: NIT Raipur admits B.Arch via JoSAA/CSAB (JEE Main Paper 2); private colleges (Amity Raipur, Durg/Bhilai colleges) admit on NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 with state counselling. Source is an aggregator guide dated 2023-24; state counselling authority and NRI rule not verified.

Karnataka.text: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) runs state B.Arch counselling for government, university, aided and private colleges using NATA (or JEE Main Paper 2) scores with 50% weightage to 10+2 marks and 50% to NATA/JEE; candidates upload the NATA scorecard on the KEA portal. COMEDK separately counsels its member private architecture colleges on NATA/JEE Paper 2A (B.Arch) or 2B (B.Plan) scores, with General Merit and Kalyana Karnataka Region seat types and no separate entrance test (2026-27 notification dated 22 June 2026).

Kerala.text: The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE Kerala, cee.kerala.gov.in) runs centralised online B.Arch allotment for government, aided and self-financing colleges; the 2025 first allotment had candidates join by 31 July-4 August 2025. A valid NATA score is needed; aggregators disagree on whether the KEAM architecture rank list is also required, so students should confirm in the CEE prospectus. Fees in 2025-26 were Rs 8,650 in government/aided autonomous colleges and roughly Rs 55,000-1,12,500 in self-financing colleges, by seat category.

Tamil Nadu.text: B.Arch seats in Anna University-affiliated and government-aided colleges are allotted through Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA/DoTE) B.Arch counselling at barch.tneaonline.org; TCE Madurai's own 2025-26 and 2026-27 admission letters say first-year B.Arch is 'Allotted through DOTE Counselling', with fee waiver for 7.5% government-school students. NIT Tiruchirappalli is outside TNEA and admits through JoSAA/CSAB (JEE Main Paper 2A) and DASA. Whether NATA or JEE Paper 2 is the qualifying score is stated differently by aggregators, so confirm in the current TNEA B.Arch brochure.

Andhra Pradesh.text: B.Arch admission is run by APSCHE (the 2025-26 cycle was conducted by JNTUA Ananthapuramu on its behalf) on NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 scores normalised into a State Architecture Rank (SAR); in affiliated colleges 85% of convener-quota seats are reserved for AP local candidates. SPA Vijayawada (central institute) is separate and admits via JoSAA/CSAB and DASA.

Telangana.text: The Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) conducts B.Arch counselling (portal barchadm.tgche.ac.in) separately from TG EAPCET; seats go by State Architecture Rank, with 50% weight to Class 12 marks and 50% to NATA/JEE Paper 2. In 2025 nine colleges offered 705 seats in Phase 1, JNAFAU School of Planning and Architecture being the government option (85 seats).

Puducherry.text: Government-quota B.Arch seats (50%) are allotted by the Centralized Admission Committee (CENTAC) and management-quota seats (50%) through the private colleges' association test (CETPPEC); merit uses 50% NATA/JEE Architecture score and 50% qualifying-exam marks, as stated in the Sri Manakula Vinayagar admission procedure sheet. CENTAC invited B.Arch applications in July 2025.

West Bengal.text: WBJEEB (wbjeeb.nic.in) runs centralised counselling for B.Tech, B.Pharm and B.Arch in state institutions on WBJEE rank (2025 counselling began 28 Aug 2025, with a decentralised round for vacant seats); IIEST and IIT KGP are separate (JoSAA/CSAB, IIT KGP via JEE Advanced AAT). Whether Jadavpur also requires NATA and the home-state quota share are not confirmed from official sources.

Odisha.text: Per an aggregator, B.Arch seats are filled via OJEE (OJEEB), NATA or JEE Main Paper 2 (plus KIITEE for KIIT) with a 50% aggregate and a valid NATA/Paper 2 score; NIT Rourkela is via JoSAA. No management/NRI quota rule was found.

Bihar.text: BCECEB (bceceboard.bihar.gov.in) conducts entrance and counselling for B.Arch in state institutions per an older exam page; NIT Patna is via JoSAA. Current-year B.Arch notice (ADV_UGEAC25_08) could not be fetched.

Jharkhand.text: BIT Mesra admits B.Arch both through JoSAA/CSAB (JEE Main Paper 2) and its own NATA-score round (2025 guidelines dated 2 July 2025).

Assam.text: Collegedunia and Careers360 list two or three B.Arch institutions in Guwahati (ASTU, Guwahati College of Architecture, Royal School of Architecture) admitting on NATA / JEE Main Paper 2; the state counselling authority was not verified.

Mizoram.text: Mizoram University fills about 60% of B.Arch seats through JEE Main / CSAB and about 40% through its own architecture entrance, with NATA required (aggregator).

Other North-East.text: A CoA-list summary (April 2024) counted 2 approved institutes in Assam, 1 each in Bihar, Jharkhand, Meghalaya and Mizoram and 6 in Odisha; Meghalaya's institute was not identified.
